description: Long-running daemon. Every 1800s, paginates the GitHub Search API at https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=topic:mcp-server+OR+topic:model-context-protocol+OR+topic:modelcontextprotocol&per_page=100&page=<n>&sort=updated&order=desc. Sets headers: Accept 'application/vnd.github+json', X-GitHub-Api-Version '2022-11-28', User-Agent 'zo-sentinel/1.0 (mcp-trust-intelligence)'. Reads optional Authorization 'Bearer ' + os.environ.get('GITHUB_TOKEN') header if env var is set; if absent, runs unauthenticated (lower rate limit, still works). Tracks page cursor in /home/workspace/zo_sentinel/state/github_pagination_cursor.json with shape {"page": int, "total_count": int, "updated_at": iso}. ON EACH CYCLE: reads cursor.page (default 1), fetches one page, parses response.items[] (GitHub returns 100 max per page, max 1000 total via search). For each repo, ws_write to mcp_discovery_candidates with row {candidate_name=full_name, candidate_url=html_url, candidate_description=(description or '')[:500], discovered_in_directory='github_topic', discovered_status='active', last_seen=now, promoted=FALSE}. Schema note: mcp_discovery_candidates UNIQUE constraint is on (discovered_in_directory, candidate_name); WriteService handles upsert. VERIFY column shape via SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='mcp_discovery_candidates' before first write. Advances cursor.page after successful fetch. When total_count is reached OR page > 10 (GitHub search caps at 1000 results), resets cursor.page to 1 and rotates the search query order (sort=updated then sort=stars then sort=forks) to surface different slices of the corpus across rotation cycles. RATE-LIMIT HANDLING: parse response headers X-RateLimit-Remaining (int), X-RateLimit-Reset (epoch sec). If Remaining < 5, sleep until Reset + 30s before next fetch. On HTTP 403 with rate-limit body (message contains 'rate limit'), back off and skip cycle. Heartbeat thread every 30s writing service_health row {service='discovery_github_paginator', last_heartbeat=ISO}. Single-instance lockfile at /home/workspace/logs/discovery_github_paginator.lock. Imports: requests, json, datetime, threading, time, os, sys, pathlib only. NO duckdb, NO sqlite3, NO project imports. Polite inter-fetch sleep 1s when authenticated, 6s when unauthenticated. Logs structured INFO line per cycle: 'cycle done page=<n> total=<t> seen=<s> written=<w> rl_remaining=<rl> errors=<e>'. CRITICAL: NEVER writes to mcp_server_registry; this is discovery-only. A separate candidate_github_promoter daemon will move github candidates into the registry.
